verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document proactive alerts when a metric moves against plan, or reminders as a reporting deadline approaches. The only documented alerts are Slack/Teams notifications for AI mapping suggestions, which is a different feature. Scan variance analysis is user-initiated with a chosen threshold, and 'monitor metrics in real-time' describes dashboards, not push notifications.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform notifies me when a metric moves against plan or a reporting deadline approaches, before I ask
